title: 1.01 / Welcome to Spectrum
slide_intent: Describe services in terms a customer can connect to everyday activities.
strategic_value: A common icon and naming structure can make TV, Internet and Voice feel like parts of one Spectrum offer.
demonstration: An introductory company statement sits over three equal service columns with device icons, cyan names and italic benefit statements.
practical_value: Use parallel descriptions to compare related services without giving one an unintended visual priority.

content_islands.name: Introduction
content_islands.spec: Keep the section title at upper left and the company explanation across the upper middle.

content_islands.name: Service trio
content_islands.spec: Align television, laptop and telephone icons over matching service names and benefit copy in three columns, divided by thin vertical rules.
